title: Commission Tier/Flat — export Modified On is UTC (NM-4195 regression)
requirementSource: NM-4195: the exported Modified On must match the grid's local time
stepsToReproduce: Open Setup → Commissions → Tier/Flat for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/commissions/tiers) on e2e and click Search. (browser time zone America/New_York)
Note Modified On of the first row.
Click Export and read the same row's Modified On.
expectedBehavior: The same time as the grid.
actualBehavior: Grid "11/12/2026, 07:30 AM"; export "11/12/2026 12:30:04 PM" — five hours later (UTC), and in a different format.

verificationLog.finding: Failed in the full read-only run (TF_WRITES=off) and confirmed by a separate DOM probe of the live page.
